datasets.name: exec_kpi
queryLines:
SELECT r.source_name, COUNT(*) AS runs, COUNT_IF(r.status = 'SUCCESS') AS successful,
       COUNT_IF(r.status = 'PARTIAL_SUCCESS') AS partial, COUNT_IF(r.status = 'FAILED') AS failed,
       COALESCE(SUM(t.retries), 0) AS retries
FROM workspace.met_audit.run_log r
LEFT JOIN (SELECT run_id, SUM(retry_count) AS retries FROM workspace.met_audit.run_log_dtl GROUP BY run_id) t USING (run_id)
WHERE r.start_time >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS AND r.status <> 'RUNNING'
GROUP BY r.source_name

datasets.name: job_kpi
datasets.displayName: Databricks job runs (7 days, all sources)
queryLines:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT run_id) AS job_runs,
       COUNT(DISTINCT IF(result_state IN ('SKIPPED', 'CANCELLED', 'UPSTREAM_CANCELLED', 'EXCLUDED'), run_id, NULL))
         AS skipped_or_cancelled,
       COUNT(DISTINCT IF(result_state IN ('FAILED', 'ERROR', 'TIMED_OUT'), run_id, NULL)) AS job_failed
FROM system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline
WHERE job_id IN (SELECT job_id FROM system.lakeflow.jobs WHERE name LIKE '%api_ingest_job%') AND period_start_time >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS

datasets.name: perf
queryLines:
SELECT r.source_name, r.run_id, r.start_time, r.status, r.duration_seconds,
       ROUND(AVG(timestampdiff(MILLISECOND, d.start_time, d.end_time)) / 1000.0, 2) AS avg_extraction_seconds
FROM workspace.met_audit.run_log_dtl d JOIN workspace.met_audit.run_log r USING (run_id)
WHERE r.status <> 'RUNNING' AND r.start_time >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
GROUP BY r.source_name, r.run_id, r.start_time, r.status, r.duration_seconds

datasets.name: stages
datasets.displayName: Job task duration by stage (all sources)
queryLines:
SELECT task_key AS stage, ROUND(AVG(timestampdiff(MILLISECOND, period_start_time, period_end_time)) / 1000.0, 1)
         AS avg_seconds, COUNT(*) AS task_runs
FROM system.lakeflow.job_task_run_timeline
WHERE job_id IN (SELECT job_id FROM system.lakeflow.jobs WHERE name LIKE '%api_ingest_job%') AND period_start_time >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
GROUP BY task_key

datasets.name: ingest
queryLines:
SELECT r.source_name, r.run_id, r.start_time, r.source_rows, r.silver_valid_rows AS target_rows,
       r.silver_rows_inserted + r.silver_rows_updated AS rows_written,
       ROUND(r.source_rows / NULLIF(r.duration_seconds, 0), 1) AS rows_per_second
FROM workspace.met_audit.run_log r WHERE r.start_time >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS AND r.status <> 'RUNNING'

datasets.name: ingest_long
datasets.displayName: Source vs target records per run
queryLines:
SELECT r.source_name, r.start_time, 'source records' AS measure, r.source_rows AS record_count
FROM workspace.met_audit.run_log r WHERE r.start_time >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS AND r.status <> 'RUNNING'
UNION ALL
SELECT r.source_name, r.start_time, 'target records (silver)', r.silver_valid_rows FROM workspace.met_audit.run_log r WHERE r.start_time >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS AND r.status <> 'RUNNING'

datasets.name: dq
queryLines:
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT r.source_name, SUM(r.source_rows) AS source_rows, SUM(r.silver_valid_rows) AS valid_rows,
         SUM(r.quarantine_rows) AS rejected_rows
  FROM workspace.met_audit.run_log r WHERE r.start_time >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS AND r.status <> 'RUNNING' GROUP BY r.source_name),
q AS (
  SELECT source_name,
         COUNT_IF(exists(dq_errors, e -> e LIKE 'DUPLICATE%')) AS duplicate_rows,
         COUNT_IF(exists(dq_errors, e -> e LIKE 'NULL%'))      AS null_rows
  FROM workspace.met_quarantine.data_quarantine WHERE quarantined_at >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS GROUP BY source_name)
SELECT runs.source_name, runs.source_rows, runs.valid_rows, runs.rejected_rows,
       COALESCE(q.duplicate_rows, 0) AS duplicate_rows, COALESCE(q.null_rows, 0) AS null_rows,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(q.null_rows, 0) / NULLIF(runs.source_rows, 0), 3) AS null_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * runs.rejected_rows / NULLIF(runs.source_rows, 0), 3) AS rejection_pct
FROM runs LEFT JOIN q USING (source_name)

datasets.name: reasons
queryLines:
SELECT source_name, reason, COUNT(*) AS rows_quarantined
FROM workspace.met_quarantine.data_quarantine LATERAL VIEW explode(dq_errors) x AS reason GROUP BY source_name, reason

datasets.name: sla
queryLines:
SELECT r.source_name, r.run_id, r.start_time, r.status, r.duration_seconds,
       timestampadd(SECOND, 300, r.start_time)                               AS expected_completion,
       timestampadd(SECOND, CAST(r.duration_seconds AS INT), r.start_time)        AS actual_completion,
       IF(r.status = 'FAILED' OR r.duration_seconds > 300, 'BREACHED', 'MET') AS sla_status,
       IF(r.status = 'FAILED' OR r.duration_seconds > 300, 1, 0)              AS breach,
       IF(r.status = 'FAILED' OR r.duration_seconds > 300, 0, 100)            AS met_pct
FROM workspace.met_audit.run_log r WHERE r.start_time >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS AND r.status <> 'RUNNING'

datasets.name: fresh
queryLines:
SELECT r.source_name, d.entity_name, MAX(d.end_time) AS last_successful_load,
       ROUND(timestampdiff(MINUTE, MAX(d.end_time), current_timestamp()) / 60.0, 1) AS hours_since_load,
       IF(timestampdiff(HOUR, MAX(d.end_time), current_timestamp()) <= 24, 'OK', 'STALE') AS freshness_sla,
       IF(timestampdiff(HOUR, MAX(d.end_time), current_timestamp()) <= 24, 0, 1) AS stale
FROM workspace.met_audit.run_log_dtl d JOIN workspace.met_audit.run_log r USING (run_id) WHERE d.status = 'SUCCESS' GROUP BY r.source_name, d.entity_name

datasets.name: latency
queryLines:
SELECT r.source_name, r.run_id, r.start_time,
       ROUND(timestampdiff(MILLISECOND, MAX(d.end_time),
             timestampadd(SECOND, CAST(r.duration_seconds AS INT), r.start_time)) / 1000.0, 1)
         AS source_to_target_seconds
FROM workspace.met_audit.run_log_dtl d JOIN workspace.met_audit.run_log r USING (run_id) WHERE r.start_time >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS AND r.status <> 'RUNNING' AND d.status = 'SUCCESS'
GROUP BY r.source_name, r.run_id, r.start_time, r.duration_seconds

datasets.name: dbu
datasets.displayName: DBU consumption of the job (30 days, all sources)
queryLines:
SELECT usage_date, sku_name, ROUND(SUM(usage_quantity), 3) AS dbu
FROM system.billing.usage
WHERE usage_metadata.job_id IN (SELECT job_id FROM system.lakeflow.jobs WHERE name LIKE '%api_ingest_job%') AND usage_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
GROUP BY usage_date, sku_name

datasets.name: errors
queryLines:
SELECT r.source_name, CASE
             WHEN d.error_type IN ('TIMEOUT', 'CONNECTION_ERROR', 'REQUEST_ERROR', 'PAGINATION_LIMIT')
                  OR d.error_type LIKE 'HTTP%' THEN '1 extraction'
             WHEN d.error_type IN ('NO_VALID_ROWS') THEN '3 data quality'
             WHEN d.error_type = 'UNEXPECTED_ERROR' THEN '5 unexpected'
             ELSE '2 parse & contract' END AS stage, d.error_type AS error_code, COUNT(*) AS failures,
       MAX(d.start_time) AS last_seen
FROM workspace.met_audit.run_log_dtl d JOIN workspace.met_audit.run_log r USING (run_id) WHERE d.status = 'FAILED' GROUP BY ALL
UNION ALL
SELECT r.source_name, '4 persist / run', 'RUN_FAILED', COUNT(*), MAX(r.start_time)
FROM workspace.met_audit.run_log r WHERE r.status = 'FAILED' GROUP BY r.source_name

datasets.name: exceptions
queryLines:
SELECT r.source_name, d.start_time, d.entity_name, CASE
             WHEN d.error_type IN ('TIMEOUT', 'CONNECTION_ERROR', 'REQUEST_ERROR', 'PAGINATION_LIMIT')
                  OR d.error_type LIKE 'HTTP%' THEN '1 extraction'
             WHEN d.error_type IN ('NO_VALID_ROWS') THEN '3 data quality'
             WHEN d.error_type = 'UNEXPECTED_ERROR' THEN '5 unexpected'
             ELSE '2 parse & contract' END AS stage, d.error_type AS error_code,
       d.http_status, d.attempt_count, d.error_message
FROM workspace.met_audit.run_log_dtl d JOIN workspace.met_audit.run_log r USING (run_id) WHERE d.status = 'FAILED'
UNION ALL
SELECT r.source_name, r.start_time, '(run)', '4 persist / run', 'RUN_FAILED', NULL, NULL, r.error_message
FROM workspace.met_audit.run_log r WHERE r.status = 'FAILED'

datasets.name: recon
queryLines:
SELECT r.source_name, r.run_id, r.start_time, r.status, r.source_rows, t.valid AS dq_valid,
       t.rejected AS dq_rejected, r.source_rows - t.valid - t.rejected AS source_vs_dq_diff,
       r.silver_valid_rows, r.silver_valid_rows - t.valid AS dq_vs_silver_diff,
       r.silver_rows_inserted, r.silver_rows_updated,
       r.silver_valid_rows - r.silver_rows_inserted - r.silver_rows_updated AS silver_unchanged,
       IF(r.source_rows - t.valid - t.rejected = 0 AND r.silver_valid_rows = t.valid, 'OK', 'MISMATCH') AS recon_status,
       IF(r.source_rows - t.valid - t.rejected = 0 AND r.silver_valid_rows = t.valid, 0, 1) AS mismatch
FROM workspace.met_audit.run_log r
JOIN (SELECT run_id, SUM(records_valid) AS valid, SUM(records_rejected) AS rejected
      FROM workspace.met_audit.run_log_dtl GROUP BY run_id) t USING (run_id)
WHERE r.status <> 'RUNNING'

datasets.name: edge_runs
queryLines:
SELECT start_time, source_name, test_mode, status, job_failed, quarantine_rows, schema_events, error_message
FROM workspace.met_audit_edge.run_log WHERE status <> 'RUNNING'

datasets.name: edge_q
queryLines:
SELECT q.quarantined_at, q.source_name, r.test_mode, q.entity_id, q.rejection_level,
       array_join(q.dq_errors, ', ') AS dq_errors, CAST(q.raw_values AS STRING) AS raw_values, q.error_details
FROM workspace.met_quarantine_edge.data_quarantine q JOIN workspace.met_audit_edge.run_log r USING (run_id)

datasets.name: edge_s
queryLines:
SELECT s.detected_at, s.source_name, r.test_mode, s.entity_id, s.change_type, s.field_name, s.actual_type
FROM workspace.met_audit_edge.schema_change_log s JOIN workspace.met_audit_edge.run_log r USING (run_id)

datasets.name: edge_f
queryLines:
SELECT r.start_time, r.source_name, r.test_mode, d.entity_name, d.http_status, d.attempt_count, d.error_type,
       d.error_message
FROM workspace.met_audit_edge.run_log_dtl d JOIN workspace.met_audit_edge.run_log r USING (run_id) WHERE d.status = 'FAILED'

Tiles marked *all sources* come from Databricks system tables (job level) and ignore the Source filter.

lines: Serverless compute: CPU, memory and cluster utilisation are managed by Databricks and not exposed (`system.compute.node_timeline` covers classic clusters only). Cost is tracked as DBU consumption from `system.billing.usage` for this job.

`source_rows = dq_valid + dq_rejected` (rows formed from payloads) and `silver_valid_rows = dq_valid` (rows sent to the silver MERGE); `silver_unchanged = valid − inserted − updated`. Any difference ≠ 0 is a MISMATCH.
Fault-injected runs (fixture mode) in the `*_edge` schemas (`met_audit_edge`, `met_quarantine_edge`, ...), so demo data never reaches the main tables.
